blocks.text: Thank you for agreeing to take my turn on the holiday coverage rota, which puts you on the main line and the shared inbox on Tuesday morning while I am still traveling back, and I will take one of your turns later in the summer so that the arrangement evens out between us. I have updated the shared calendar to show the swap under both our names, and my out-of-office reply now directs anyone who writes to me to you.

Most of what comes in that morning will be routine and can wait until I am back at my desk in the afternoon. If something cannot wait, please forward it to me by email with a line on top, and I will deal with it as soon as I am off the road.
